steps.run: (() => { window.qaVisible = element => { if (!element || !element.checkVisibility({ checkOpacity: true, checkVisibilityCSS: true }) || element.closest('[inert]')) return false; const box = element.getBoundingClientRect(); return box.width > 0 && box.height > 0 && box.left >= 0 && box.top >= 0 && box.right <= innerWidth && box.bottom <= innerHeight && [[.5,.5],[.2,.2],[.8,.2],[.2,.8],[.8,.8]].every(([x,y]) => element.contains(document.elementFromPoint(box.left + box.width*x, box.top + box.height*y))); }; return { visibilityChecksUseHitTests: true }; })()

(async () => { window.headlessRequest = async (path, body, headers = {}) => { const response = await fetch('/api' + path, { method: body === undefined ? 'GET' : 'POST', headers: { authorization: 'Bearer ' + localStorage.getItem('independum.accessToken'), 'content-type': 'application/json', ...headers }, body: body === undefined ? undefined : JSON.stringify(body) }); if (!response.ok) throw new Error('The headless QA request fails.'); return response.status === 204 ? null : response.json(); }; window.headlessOriginal = new URL(location.href).searchParams.get('chat'); const receipt = await window.headlessRequest('/prompt', { requestId: 'qa-headless-active', chatId: window.headlessOriginal, text: 'Check network permissions.', isLiteral: true }); window.headlessActive = receipt; const required = await window.headlessRequest('/operations/' + receipt.operationId + '/wait'); const settled = await window.headlessRequest('/operations/' + receipt.operationId + '/wait?onQuestion=wait'); return { selectedChatUnchanged: new URL(location.href).searchParams.get('chat') === window.headlessOriginal, approvalNamed: required.code === 'approvalRequired' && typeof required.toolCallId === 'string', finalTextAvailable: settled.text?.startsWith('Preview reply complete.') }; })()

(async () => { const agent = await window.headlessRequest('/chats/' + window.headlessOriginal + '/agent'); const profile = agent.configuration.profile; const body = { ...profile.document, profile: { ...profile.document.profile, settings: { ...profile.document.profile.settings, model: { providerId: 'faux', modelId: 'faux-typing' } } } }; const response = await fetch('/api/profiles/user/default?projectId=' + encodeURIComponent(profile.projectId), { method: 'PUT', headers: { authorization: 'Bearer ' + localStorage.getItem('independum.accessToken'), 'content-type': 'application/json', 'If-Match': profile.revision }, body: JSON.stringify(body) }); if (!response.ok) throw new Error('The headless profile save fails.'); const state = await window.headlessRequest('/chats/' + window.headlessOriginal); window.headlessNew = await window.headlessRequest('/prompt', { requestId: 'qa-headless-new', project: state.folder, profile: { scope: 'user', id: 'default' }, text: 'Headless new task.', isLiteral: true }); await window.headlessRequest('/operations/' + window.headlessNew.operationId + '/wait?onQuestion=wait'); return { newChatIsDistinct: window.headlessNew.chatId !== window.headlessOriginal, originalStaysSelected: new URL(location.href).searchParams.get('chat') === window.headlessOriginal }; })()
